title: TurkBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Turkish Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures knowledge of religious culture (as part of the MMLU subtask) and the detection of stereotypes or biases related to religion (as part of the Toxicity and Bias Detection tasks).
findings: The paper presents overall performance metrics for all models across 21 tasks but does not provide specific findings broken down by the religious content subtasks. The general findings indicate that larger models consistently outperform smaller ones, but even state-of-the-art systems struggle with culturally grounded reasoning tasks.
